issues.detail: The Greek 'πως αρεσει τη γυναικι' (how it pleases the woman) is rendered as 'tìm cách làm đẹp lòng vợ' (find ways to please the wife). The Greek describes a state of being/manner (how it pleases her), whereas the Vietnamese implies an active intent or method ('tìm cách' - find ways) not present in the Greek text.
